hash comparison"],"stated_reason":"Cryptographic hashes have no false negatives but give false positives for benign changes, while perceptual hashes have fewer false positives but can be evaded by an adversary.","quote":"Comparing images with cryptographic hashes has no false-negatives (i.e., any change is detected) but gives false-positives for “benign” changes, e.g., if a domain re-encodes or
